newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,251 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,251 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,251 contracts compared with 969 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 50 wheat, 161 corn, 878 soybean, 109 soymeal, 53 soyoil, seven soybean calls and 39 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 to 1/2 cent per bushel lower, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/2 cent lower and soybeans were six to 3-1/4 cents lower.
